chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Beware of marrying women who have been divorced three times in a single sitting, for they are still considered to have spouses."

key_terms.ذَوَاتُ أَزْوَاجٍ: women still regarded as having husbands

ai.seo_question: Can a woman divorced three times in one sitting be lawfully married by another man?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام warns against marrying women purportedly divorced three times in one sitting, indicating that such a divorce does not render them lawfully separated. The hadith concerns the legal validity of divorce and its consequences for remarriage in Islamic family law.
